notes: DEP NC Tenth Revised Leaf No. 600 (Summary of Rider Adjustments), native text PDF, 11 rate-class sections (Residential, SGS, SGS-Constant Load, Non-Demand MGS, Demand MGS, Seasonal/Intermittent, LGS, HP & LGS-RTP, Outdoor Lighting, Sports Field Lighting, Traffic Signal). Transcribed from PyMuPDF word coordinates and checked against rendered pages. Each section: 'Annual Billing Adjustments Rider BA' group header (no value) with indented sub-rows (Fuel rate, EMF, DSM/EE) whose sum is printed as 'Annual Billing Adjustments Rider BA - Net Adjustment' (recorded as is_total=true, subtotal=true; excluded from TOTAL components). Sections split across pages: Small General Service - Constant Load (p1-p2), Demand MGS (p2-p3; its TOTAL cents/kWh and the $/kW JAA row + TOTAL dollars/kW are on p3), Sports Field Lighting (p4-p5). Units: $/kW (dollars/kW column) appear ONLY for JAA in Demand MGS (0.92), LGS (3.03) and HP/LGS-RTP (3.03); everything else is cents/kWh. HP & LGS-RTP has two cents/kWh columns (Baseline, Incremental) recorded with field 'column'. Quarterly Fuel Adjustment has no rider code printed. All checksums pass.
